tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: All measured parameters are within normal limits except for a mildly decreased creatinine, which may reflect reduced muscle mass common in elderly patients rather than renal dysfunction. No acute metabolic or electrolyte disturbances are evident. Correlate with clinical context if further evaluation is needed.
